description: Prepares a post in upTake's Write studio, in the maker's voice and with tracked links, and returns the text for each network. Nothing is published or scheduled: the maker reviews and sends it from upTake. Counts against the maker's monthly drafts (a rewrite when the network already has a version). Takes up to a minute.

about.description: Items the post is about, with ids read from uptake_overview (moves_this_week, next_moment_id), uptake_ideas, or uptake_data (releases_30d, moments).

networks.description: Networks to write for, up to 5: hackernews, indiehackers, producthunt, x, linkedin, reddit, changelog, bluesky, mastodon, devto, newsletter, discord. Default: the maker's networks.

post_id.description: Rework an existing post instead of starting a new one.

project.description: Which project: its id or site (example.com) from uptake_projects. Optional when the maker has a single project.

request.description: What the post should say, as the maker would ask it in upTake (what changed, for whom, why it matters). Facts only: upTake never invents numbers.

name: uptake_write_post
title: Write a post
